_comment: PRESET: digital templates. Price bands are USD, from docs/research-findings-2026-11-23.md addendum §F (live-listing bands from seller tools, directional). Pricing block: digital has NO production or shipping cost. HOW THIS DIFFERS FROM digital-downloads: that preset sells design ASSETS (SVG cut files, patterns, printables — raw material buyers make things FROM). This preset sells finished editable DOCUMENTS and systems (planners, resumes, business templates — the buyer customises the words and uses the document itself). Canva rule that shapes delivery: templates containing Canva Pro content may only be sold as a shareable Canva template LINK (delivered inside a PDF), never as an off-platform file; creating template links needs a paid Canva plan. PLR/MRR bundles do NOT satisfy Etsy's original-design rule — templates must be yours.

creation_path: Stage 3 research names the niche version (ADHD, budget, homeschool, a trade) — generic 'planner template' has ~934K competing listings (tool data); the niche IS the product
Write the template brief: the system it encodes (pages, sections, workflow) in your structure and your words — a re-skinned PLR planner fails Etsy's original-design rule
Build the template to spec: in Canva (template link) and/or as an editable file set; test it as a buyer — open the link, duplicate, edit, export (Stage 4)
Assemble the delivery PDF (instructions + template link), <=20 MB, max 5 files per listing; price with pipeline/pricing.py at zero cost — bundles and kits carry the margin (Stage 5)
Generate the listing pack with pipeline/listing.py (Stage 6): licence terms stated (use it, never resell the template itself); publish gate (Stage 7); test-download and open your own delivery file
delivery: Instant download — the Etsy file is a PDF carrying the Canva template link (and/or editable files); no shipping, no Printify (skip Stage 2)
launch_checklist: Stage 1: intake answered — existing shop health-checked (Etsy Payments active, bank verified, shop policies set); no shop yet → appendix walkthrough first (docs/appendix-shop-creation.md)
Stage 2: SKIPPED — no Printify for downloads; note it and move on
Stage 3: niche scored with pipeline/scoring.py; confirm the templates are YOUR original work (PLR/MRR re-skins fail Etsy's Creativity Standards)
Stage 4: templates built and buyer-tested end to end; Canva template link works in a fresh account; delivery PDF assembled
Stage 5: price with the calculator at zero product/shipping cost; the bundle/kit version priced as the margin product, the single as the review-builder
Stage 6: listing pack generated; description states INSTANT DOWNLOAD, exactly what is editable and in what tool, and the licence (use for your own documents — the template itself is never resold)
Stage 7: human approves the exact files + pack; publish as a Digital listing; read back and test-download
Stage 8: watch 'how do I open this' messages — they are a delivery-PDF defect report; refresh planners annually (dated planners expire by design); weekly review

summary: Finished editable documents — niche planners, trade-specific resume systems, business document kits — delivered as instant downloads (Canva template link inside a PDF, or editable files). Research verdict (2026-11-23, addendum §F): broad template terms are among the most saturated on Etsy (canva template ~1.85M listings, median $5.34, tool data), and the winning pattern across every 2026 guide is the hyper-specific version for one brain, one trade, one business type. Bundles and kits carry the margin; singles build reviews. Templates must be your original work — PLR/MRR re-skins and Canva's own templates resold as-is both fail the rules.
